query: Читай CSV-файлы из директории /data/input/orders/, оставляй только строки где поле status равно COMPLETED, пиши результат в /data/output/completed_orders.csv.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: csv_filter_pipeline
  name: CSV Orders Filter Pipeline
  description: Read CSV files from /data/input/orders/, keep only rows where status
    equals COMPLETED, write to /data/output/completed_orders.csv
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 1 hour
sources:
- id: source_csv
  name: Read Orders CSV
  type: CSV
  location: /data/input/orders/
  connection:
    properties:
      path: /data/input/orders/
      file_pattern: '*.csv'
      delimiter: '{{CSV_DELIMITER}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_filter
  name: Filter Completed Orders
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: status == 'COMPLETED'
sinks:
- id: sink_csv
  name: Write Completed Orders CSV
  type: CSV
  location: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
  connection:
    properties:
      path: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
      delimiter: '{{CSV_DELIMITER}}'
processed_data:
- id: csv_data
  format: csv
links:
- from_id: source_csv
  to_id: process_filter
  data_ref: csv_data
- from_id: process_filter
  to_id: sink_csv
  data_ref: csv_data
